explanation: The observed Job-2 priorities all have upstream_rank 0 because the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values (s01, s02, ...), while coverage records use need record IDs (n06-r01, n06-r02, ...). The downstream prioritize function joins provenance by coverage record_id, so these identities cannot match. The supplied source for upstream assemble_provenance shows it constructs provenance rows with record_id set to record.get('source_id', '') instead of preserving record.get('record_id', ''), violating the requirement to preserve record identities and deterministic provenance handoff identities.
cited_evidence: Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while needs contains record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Observed Job-2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record, despite evidence_sources carrying ranks 1 through 8.
prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence.get('record_id', '') and looks it up using coverage.get('record_id', ''), so mismatched provenance record_id values cause rank loss.
assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the need record identity with source_id.
